#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<long long> invs(int n, long long p) {
    vector<long long> res(n);
    res[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
        res[i] = (p - (p / i) * res[p % i] % p) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k, l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;

    vector<long long> invs_arr = invs(2 * n + 4, MOD);
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    // Initialize DP
    dp[0][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        int prevMax = min(2 * n - i, i);
        int maxRunning = min(2 * n - i - 1, i + 1);
        for (int j = 0; j <= prevMax; j++) {
            if (dp[i - 1][j] != 0) {
                if (j > 0) {
                    dp[i][j - 1] = (dp[i][j - 1] + dp[i - 1][j] * j % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n - i]) % MOD;
                }
                if (j < maxRunning) {
                    dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + dp[i - 1][j] * (2 * n - i - j) % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n - i]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = k; j <= n; j++) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    ans = ans * l % MOD * invs_arr[2 * n + 1] % MOD;
    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
